r1CommandProfile.scope: Multi-station finger motor commands only; original R1 source scene, forces, gains, joint ranges and inertia are unchanged. Actual qpos/qvel are not clamped.

r1LimitPolicy: Original R1 default-soft-limit MJCF is preserved. Additional numerical guard is 1 mm; original R1 regressions did not specify a Dex1 0.2 mm bound. Saved original browser evidence includes 0.5419235 mm static finger tracking error. Actual range excess is reported, not hidden or clamped.
collisionScope: Original per-robot scenes; G1/C5 full source collision meshes, R1 original finger contacts. Separate, non-overlapping station worlds do not collide across worlds.
planningScope: Production background controller with real worker_threads bridge and shipped worker service/parser/serialization; workers are polled asynchronously between complete global 1 ms ticks. Every world time/qpos/qvel/ctrl is asserted unchanged during planning. No task motion is executed in a worker.
